name: 21037 · Edgewater, MD
findings: ZIP 21037 (Edgewater) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21037 (Edgewater) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21037 (Edgewater) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
